meta.name: eol-message
meta.description: Write a clear, empathetic EOL announcement with rationale, customer impact, and next steps. Use when retiring a product, feature, or plan without creating avoidable confusion.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 撰写清晰、共情的产品停用公告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要向用户宣布产品/功能停用，同时减少困惑和负面反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Write clear, empathetic product end-of-life announcements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to announce product/feature retirement while minimizing confusion and backlash.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你写一份产品停用（EOL）通知，包含停用原因、对客户的影响、过渡方案和后续步骤，语气清晰且富有同理心。
howto.when: 当你需要宣布某个产品、功能或计划停用，且希望避免造成客户困惑时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一份 EOL 通知，停用我们的旧版报表模块，12月31日截止。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含原因、影响和过渡方案的通知。

say.text: 起草一个产品停用公告，替换方案是新分析仪表盘，400个客户受影响。
say.note: Claude 会基于你提供的信息撰写完整公告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you write a clear, empathetic End-of-Life (EOL) announcement that includes the rationale, customer impact, transition support, and next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to announce the discontinuation of a product, feature, or plan, and want to avoid causing customer confusion.

say_en.text: Draft an EOL message for retiring our legacy reporting module, effective Dec 31.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a message with rationale, impact, and transition plan.

say_en.text: Write a product discontinuation notice, replaced by new analytics dashboard, 400 accounts affected.
say_en.note: Claude will compose a full announcement based on your input.
